component.name: AI Usage Monitor
component.summary: See AI usage, quota, resets, and spend truthfully in Plasma

description.p: AI Usage Monitor is a Plasma 6 widget for provider-reported usage and spend, synchronized coding-tool quota, local activity, balances, rate limits, and read-only connection checks. Budget Control adds typed local cost policies, real billing periods, deterministic safe-to-spend guidance and quota runway from compatible local history.

The widget stores secrets in KWallet and history on the local computer. Actual data, estimates, fixed fees, balances, connectivity, unavailable values, and currencies stay separate. Forecasts expose evidence and unavailable reasons, scoped identifiers remain local, and policy transitions persist before delivery. The KDE Store frontend requires the matching compiled plugin from the Fedora COPR package or a source build.
